documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported a consolidated total income growth of 58.60% year-on-year for Q2 FY27 and 47% growth for H1 FY27, reaching INR 194.9 crores. Management expects revenue growth to exceed 30% for FY27 and FY28, driven by strong domestic OEM demand, expanding US exports, and new European business opportunities. The company plans automation and CapEx investments of around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months to enhance productivity and save manpower costs. Despite significant spikes in input commodity prices such as tin, copper, and steel, management aims to maintain EBITDA margins between 20% and 22%, targeting 23% for the next fiscal year. Menon Bearings Limited presented its financial and operational performance for Q2 & H1FY27, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company expects additional business of around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Management estimates additional business of INR 131 crores for FY28.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%

guidance.claim: Management expects additional business of INR 157 crores for 2029.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: The management expects the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop business, the company targets INR100 crores this year and around INR125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The management considers INR360 crores to be a conservative revenue figure for the year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic OEM business grew by almost 50% and exports grew by over 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's tractor business market share dropped from 54% 10 years ago to 34% currently due to diversification into other applications.
demand_outlook.quote: 10 years back 54% of our market share was tractor business. Now it's become 34%, even the volumes are increasing.

demand_outlook.claim: A recent tour of Europe is yielding potential business of more than INR 35 crores expected to convert into sales in FY28 and FY29.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects that the visit to Canada and USA will yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: Return on investment for planned automation and machinery investments is expected to be around 2.5 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is introducing automated AI visual camera checking to inspect around 1 million engine bearing parts per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are getting automated visual -- automated AI visual camera checking, where these number of parts are getting checked by manual labour, maybe 1 million parts, like 10 lakhs parts in engine bearing every month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Brake division plans an additional ₹2.50 crore capex over the next two years after deploying ₹0.58 crore in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned a CapEx of around INR4 crores for this year in Alkop alone.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for tin increased by 72%, copper by 50%, and steel by 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins normally range between 20% and 22%.
margins_costs.quote: It will range between 20% to 22%, always there.

margins_costs.claim: Segment-wise EBITDA margins are 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: Bi-metal EBITDA margins are around 21% plus, Alkop is almost 21%, and brakes achieved 25% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Menon Alkop developed around 54 parts over the last two years, with start of business commenced.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: Implementing single-piece flow across 16 bearing lines is expected to reduce bearing manpower by 50 employees.
orders_capacity.quote: So consider that -- considering 16 lines and average reduction of three manpower shift will be the total quantum of employee reduction will be 50 alone in bearings, apart from bush and Alkop and everything.

capital_allocation.claim: The company funded its CapEx through internal accruals and did not avail any term loan over the past six months.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is availing packing credit limits from bankers at an interest rate of 4.65% to 4.75%.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that, we are availing packing credit limit from bankers, which is now available at the rate of 4.65%, 4.75% only.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sales and distribution expenses increased due to substantially higher freight costs for export shipments to the US and European countries.
risks_headwinds.quote: So far sales and distribution expenses are concerned in exports; the freight so far as shipment of exports to USA and maybe other European countries as well. That has substantially gone up, and because of that, the sales and distribution expenses have gone up substantially.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck for the last three months because of the backlog caused by the Strait of Hormuz and the war.
risks_headwinds.quote: So actually, our results could have been even better. But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects more than 30% revenue growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
management_commitments.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

management_commitments.claim: An additional ₹2.50 crore capex is planned for the Brake division over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

management_commitments.claim: The company expects railway brake business to start at around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year and eventually reach INR25 crores to INR30 crores.
management_commitments.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer is under construction and expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: The share of EV in the Alkop business can be in the range of 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: that in the Alkop business, the share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
